name: LaunchVoid

sources.title: LaunchVoid homepage — 'The Void Where Great Startups Launch'
Submit page — server-rendered content identical to homepage (form appears JS-gated)
Pricing page — server-rendered content identical to homepage (no plan details visible without JS)

requirements: Positions itself as a startup launch platform for SaaS, developer tools, and consumer apps
Submit Startup (/submit) and Pricing (/pricing) routes exist but render the same shell as the homepage — the actual form and prices load client-side or behind auth
preparation: Product name, URL, and description (inferred — form fields not publicly visible)
Expect an account or JS-enabled browser flow; have logo/screenshots ready
workflow: Open https://launchvoid.com/submit in a JS-capable browser session
Complete whatever plan selection and form the client-side app exposes
Confirm the listing appears on the site
watchFor: Site footer is carpeted with reciprocal directory badges (Fazier, Turbo0, TinyLaunch, StartupFame, etc.) — typical badge-network launch board
No pricing or review terms are publicly readable without executing the app — do not assume free
Mentions a 'LaunchForge AI' tool for landing pages/pitch decks — possible bundled upsell
countsAsLive: A public startup listing page on launchvoid.com reachable from the site (exact URL pattern not verifiable from static pages)
unknowns: Whether submission is free or paid (pricing page content did not render)
Form fields, account requirement, badge/backlink conditions
Whether the site is actively maintained (footer says © 2025)
